fusions.name: Trailing the Bitten
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy up to 6 tiles away. The strike deals 16 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Locked Jaw
fusions.desc: A bite that holds on: it deals 13 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Threat Display
fusions.desc: You pull up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Viper-Mouthed Hound
fusions.desc: A bonded hound with a viper's bite fights beside you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.
